Themes

Browse the 30 built-in themes, each with its own frame, particle effects, and color palettes, and link straight to any of them.

What a Theme Includes

A theme is a complete look: a decorative frame, an atmospheric particle effect (petals, snow, confetti, steam, and more), and a set of color palettes. Motion Poster ships with 30 themes and 276 built-in color schemes.

Switch themes any time from Customize Appearance (C). Your host names and text stay put; only the look changes.

Link Directly to a Theme

Add ?theme= and a theme ID to the poster address to open it on a specific theme, handy for previewing or sharing:

https://motionposter.ryanmarch.me/app/?theme=art-deco-gala

Theme IDs match the names above in lowercase with hyphens, for example spring, digital-grid, alpine-winter, retro-wave, and new-years-eve.

Theme-Specific Controls

Control labels adapt to the theme you choose. For example, the particle slider reads Petal Count on Spring Blossom and Snowflake Count on Alpine Winter. Some themes also add their own controls, such as wind or glow effects.
